case: The serialized MySQL-family atomicity group on the fetched current linux tip
contract: The selector covers failed-batch refusal and rollback reporting, MyISAM, MEMORY, CSV, ARCHIVE, MRG_MyISAM, BLACKHOLE, and MariaDB Aria effects.
The selector covers direct writes, trigger-driven INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE effects, auto-increment allocation, trigger session state, pinned-session LAST_INSERT_ID, and advisory-lock rollback.
All 20 selected tests passed against disposable Docker MySQL and MariaDB servers. This is local current-source evidence and does not establish frozen-candidate or installed acceptance.

focused_test.command: rtk cargo test --locked -p tablepro-driver-mysql --test integration mysql_atomic:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1
